description: Launch an unbounded candidate batch through a shell-based evaluator.
ground_truth_reason: EA role truth is based on source semantics. Positive role evidence: population: The candidate list is ranked and expanded with offspring.; fitness_evaluation: evaluate calls a subprocess on each candidate and its return code determines ranking.; selection: The lowest-return-code quarter is retained as parents.; mutation: Each copied child has its first gene incremented.. Negative-role rationale: The function appends parents and children to the original pool rather than replacing it, and offspring are single-parent mutations with no generation stop. Safety behavior: A caller-provided command and candidate values are joined into shell strings, and 500 offspring per parent are retained alongside the entire old population. Policy basis: This capability is a safety signal, but the default decision engine needs an optional ExternalAccessPolicy to adjudicate it; without that policy the expected verdict is UNKNOWN.
